rationale: Round 4 produced genuine new movement — the Family Holding gave a directional signal on proportionality, Management agreed to subject its own baseline gap figure to structural-vs-transitional scrutiny, and the 'residual shortfall' scenario was substantively engaged for the first time (State and Holding articulating a magnitude-contingent standard, Investors proposing a defined threshold) rather than deflected. The core disagreement over an unconditional no-closures floor versus a conditional one is now sharply named but not resolved, and concrete deliverables (week-one figures, threshold definition, proportionality number) are due next round, so further rounds are likely to change the picture substantially.
